import pytest
from your_module import matrix_transpose  # Replace 'your_module' with actual module name


class TestMatrixTranspose:
    """Tests for matrix_transpose function."""

    # ---------- Happy Path ----------

    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "input_matrix, expected",
        [
            ([[1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6]], [[1, 4], [2, 5], [3, 6]]),      # 2x3 -> 3x2
            ([[1, 2], [3, 4], [5, 6]], [[1, 3, 5], [2, 4, 6]]),      # 3x2 -> 2x3
            ([[1, 2], [3, 4]], [[1, 3], [2, 4]]),                     # square 2x2
            ([[1]], [[1]]),                                            # 1x1
        ],
    )
    def test_happy_path(self, input_matrix, expected):
        assert matrix_transpose(input_matrix) == expected

    # ---------- Edge Cases ----------

    def test_empty_list_returns_empty(self):
        assert matrix_transpose([]) == []

    def test_single_row(self):
        assert matrix_transpose([[1, 2, 3]]) == [[1], [2], [3]]

    def test_single_column(self):
        assert matrix_transpose([[1], [2], [3]]) == [[1, 2, 3]]

    def test_large_matrix(self):
        """Test with a larger matrix to ensure scalability."""
        m, n = 100, 50
        matrix = [[j for j in range(n)] for i in range(m)]
        transposed = matrix_transpose(matrix)
        assert len(transposed) == n
        assert len(transposed[0]) == m
        assert transposed[0][0] == matrix[0][0]
        assert transposed[0][m - 1] == matrix[m - 1][0]

    # ---------- Error / Abnormal Input Cases ----------

    def test_jagged_matrix_raises_index_error(self):
        """Non-rectangular (jagged) matrix should raise IndexError."""
        jagged = [[1, 2], [3]]
        with pytest.raises(IndexError):
            matrix_transpose(jagged)

    def test_none_input_raises_type_error(self):
        """None is not iterable -> TypeError."""
        with pytest.raises(TypeError):
            matrix_transpose(None)

    def test_string_input_raises_type_error(self):
        """String is iterable but will cause issues; expecting TypeError."""
        with pytest.raises(TypeError):
            matrix_transpose("invalid")

    def test_list_of_non_lists_raises_type_error(self):
        """Elements are not lists; accessing index on an integer will fail."""
        with pytest.raises(TypeError):
            matrix_transpose([1, 2, 3])
